X1-d-today.png.caption: Today, real: Ranger's Post out sheet on the Leave War (Fri 3 Apr). Mark X1: "Transfer to Sqn" is drawn but greyed, "Comes with the shared database"; the lit default is Overseas Sqn ("archived, account suspended").

X2-d-proposed.png.caption: Proposed, drawn in on the real sheet. X2: "Transfer to Sqn" pressable and lit. X3: a "To" row, a clone of the Posting row, naming the squadron — every squadron made in Admin → Squadrons except his own (only 149 in the demo). X4: the sheet's one line, "On 3 Apr: moves to 149, his leave, OIL, quals and inputs with him." X5: one line listing what the date touches, shown only when there is something: "After 3 Apr: 2 lines on 142's schedule hold him (kept, as a 149 man borrowed); 1 leave approved by 142 goes to 149's Approvals." (the figures are made up for the picture). The button stays "Post out".
